title: Items
html:
In Dungeon Runners there are 4 classes of items, these are:


  • Utility Items - These are items that help you when exploring dungeons and fighting monsters.


  • Weapons - These are melee and ranged weapons with which you can attack monsters.


  • Armour - This includes all armour and jewelery.


  • Quest Items - These items are gathered or used for quests.


Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Loot Ranking
  • 3 Soulbound
  • 4 Name Descriptions

Description

You can find these items by defeating enemies, purchasing them from merchants in Townston and Dew Valley or from chests in dungeons. Weapons and armor found from defeating monsters or from chests are usually referred to as Loot. Items have six different rankings and the higher the ranking the better the loot. There is a seventh ranking which is for quest items and kings coins. Many Rare (Yellow) and Unique (Purple), and most Mythic (Rainbow) items are marked as Member only. To find out more about Members please visit Members. Loot in Dungeon Runners is one of the most important things - people often Farm monsters to get good items like Purples. Rarely, a lucky farmer finds a Mythic item, which "mythically" glows in rainbow colors at the item name.

Loot Ranking

Normal (Grey)
These items are displayed with a grey item name. They are very basic, and sell for only a few gold.
. .
Superior (Green)
These items are displayed with a green item name.  They usually have some attribute bonuses.  The weapons Merchants usually have these items in their Scrap Heap.
. .
Magic (Blue)
These items are displayed with a blue item name.  They have total attribute bonuses approximately equal to level, plus one or more additional bonuses.  Beginners should strive to equip items at least this level. The weapons Merchants usually have these items in their Scrap Heap.
. .
Rare (Yellow)
These items are displayed with a yellow item name. They have total attribute bonuses approximately equal to level, plus several additional bonuses.  They can be sold to the vendors for reasonable amount of gold.  Higher level players strive to have items at least this level.  Only 50% of these items dropped by mobs can be used by non-members.  The Weapons Merchants usually have mostly items of this level in their Weapons and Armor categories.  The Token Masters sell items of at least this quality for Kings Coins, and items purchased from them will be Soulbound immediately.
. .
Unique (Purple)
These items are displayed with a purple item name. They have attribute bonuses which total a bit more than their level, plus lots of additional bonuses. They are highly coveted and you should equip as many as possible.  They also have high gold value when sold.  These items are Soulbound within 10 minutes. Only 25% of these items dropped by mobs can be used by non-members.  Occasionally the weapons Merchants offer items of this quality.  The Amazon and Sam's Dungeon Wholesale sell mostly purple items for gold, and Gypsy Sally for Kings Coins.
. .
Mythic (Rainbows)
Rainbow Items are displayed with a rainbow-coloured item name. They have high attribute bonuses plus many additional bonuses and are highly sought after. They also have very high gold value when sold.  L100 characters covet these items.  They are Soulbound within 10 minutes. Only 5% of these items dropped by mobs can be used by non-members.  Occasionally The Amazon offers rainbow items, and both Gypsy Sally and Sam's Dungeon Wholesale sometime appear in rainbow versions. Here is a listing of known Rainbow Items.
. .
Quest items (Teal)
These are displayed with a teal or blue green coloured item name. They are objects of quests, such as Antique Singing Swords or F3 Schwag Bags.  These items are automatically Soulbound.  Normally they have no gold value but can only be turned in to the quest giver.
. .
Relic items (Orange-Yellow, Pulsating Glow)
These items are automatically Soulbound and are part of Relic Quests. They are almost always found in light-colored Ancient Relic Chests.  They can be sold for money at the vendors or the quest can be completed with Tilles the Sellout for Kings Coins.

You can use the GENERAL control panel to set the minimum type of item that will be displayed when you press the Alt button.  For example, if you set Magic (Blue) as your minimum, only Blue items and up (Yellow, Purple, Rainbow) will be visible when you press the Alt button. Other items (Grey and Green) will not have their name appear when the Alt button is pressed, but you can still view their name and pick them up by manually hovering the mouse over the item.

Soulbound

Soulbound is the term in Dungeon Runners which means that items can only be used by the person that owns them. Quest items and Kings Coins are soulbound. Some items have the text Soulbound in 10 minutes in their description. This means that for the first 10 minutes the items are worn they can be traded to other players, but after this time they are soulbound. Items recieved from Sam's Dungeon Wholesale and from the Token Masters are soulbound immediately upon purchase.

Note: Unlike some other games, this Soulbound timer only decreases when the item is worn. It does not decrease while the item is in your inventory, in the bank, or even dropped on the ground.

Name Descriptions

While the names of items (especially weapons and armor) may seem arbitrary, there is a recognizable system with which items are named.

An example is the apparent system in which animal names are used to denote primary attribute modifiers. For instance, fighter armor with the animal description 'Beetle' in the name always has one primary attribute modifier, and it is always Endurance. Fighter armor with other descriptions (i.e. 'Panda', 'Liger') have varying primary attribute modifiers; however, a system can be seen in which all 'Panda' armor has a consistent number and type of primary attribute modifier.

Recognizing the system relative to a player's particular class and style of play can be extremely helpful. Using the above example, a fighter that wishes to tank can seek out 'Crystal' 'Beetle' armor, since this armor consistently has a high defense rating and an Endurance bonus.
